label: prf:confinement-level-exists
title: Proof of confinement level exists
html:
Proof. Proof of confinement level exists

Proof. The Hecke normal form T_w is a finite linear combination of basis elements \{T_v : v \in S_{n(K)}\}, each indexed by a permutation of size n(K). The set of partitions \{\lambda \vdash k : k \leq k_{\max}\} is finite (bounded by the partition function p(k_{\max})). Therefore, the filtration J^\bullet(q) has finitely many distinct levels. The minimum \ell such that T_w \in J^\ell(q) is achieved by some \ell \in \{0, 1, \ldots, m\}, where m is the number of distinct nonzero shadow-price values at q.

The confinement level reaches its maximum \ell(K, q) = m when T_w requires the top-energy operator. It achieves its minimum \ell(K, q) = 0 when T_w lies entirely in the trivial 1-dimensional blocks \{(k), (1^k)\}. \square
